name: out-of-book-v1
notes: Questions a Class 10 student may ask that the NCERT Science X 2026-27 book does NOT answer. Used with retrieval-v1 (in-book) to calibrate the Curriculum Retrieval agent's 'not in the textbook' detection.
Each topic was checked against document_chunks (ILIKE on key terms) on 2026-11-13: 0 matches, or only passing mentions (Newton's prism, 'evolution of organisms'), which makes them hard cases.
Excluded because the book mentions them: electric motor, generator, refrigerator, meiosis, global warming.
kind: removed = dropped from the 2026-27 syllabus or formative-only; class9 = taught in Class 9; beyond = not school syllabus.
Telugu items written by the assistant: review with a native speaker.
